facts.content: Patient presents with a severe left-sided headache with sudden onset since midday.

facts.content: The headache is described as throbbing and worsens with movement such as leaning forward or moving the head and neck.
facts.source_text: Throbbing pain, worsens with movement (leaning forward, moving head/neck)

facts.content: Patient experienced a visual aura with zigzag lines and bilateral blurred vision before the headache.
facts.source_text: Visual aura: zigzag lines, bilateral blurred vision before headache

facts.content: The patient has photophobia and is wearing sunglasses indoors.

facts.content: The patient has nausea and has vomited twice.

facts.content: There was a similar headache episode a few weeks ago that lasted 2 days, improved with painkillers and rest, and required sick leave.
facts.source_text: Similar episode a few weeks ago (lasted 2 days, improved with painkillers/rest, required sick leave)

facts.content: The patient reports no prior history of migraines.
